design_intent: race budget B is user-selected per race and may be 1000, 10000, or another 100-JPY-aligned amount
qualify tickets only when preregistered EV gate passes
never exceed race budget or preregistered ticket/bet-type/correlation caps
important_limitations: fractional Kelly is used only as a ticket scoring candidate; correlated exotic tickets make naive independent-ticket Kelly non-optimal
EV thresholds, caps, allocation method, and deploy fraction are not yet locked for real use
synthetic PASS is not evidence of profitability or calibration quality
questions_for_auditor: Does the allocator fail closed on invalid tickets and obey all monetary caps?
Does variable budget scaling introduce any hidden stake-cap inconsistency?
Is the unit-by-unit score/(1+n) balancing deterministic and free of obvious budget/cap bugs?
Is fractional-Kelly wording sufficiently conservative given correlated tickets?
What machine tests are still required before this allocator can be eligible for DEV ticket-allocation research?
hard_rule: PASS may authorize only additional synthetic/DEV plumbing work. It must not authorize real betting, VALIDATION, or OOS.
